backend.wipPathAndContentManifestAlgorithm: From the backend worktree, emit git ls-files --modified --others --exclude-standard as NUL-delimited paths, sort paths bytewise with sort -z, run shasum -a 256 for every path in that order using the exact '<hex><two spaces><path><newline>' output, then hash that complete manifest with shasum -a 256.
backend.porcelainAlgorithm: From the backend worktree, hash the exact bytes emitted by git status --porcelain=v1 with shasum -a 256.
backend.instruction: Continue the preserved WIP in place; do not discard, copy, merge, rebase or cherry-pick.

moduleImplementationRequirements: Complete Time close validation, CAS close, forward-only reopen, immutable blocker and result snapshots, separation of duties, step-up validation, transactional events and handoff lineage from the inherited token.
Keep Time V12 as the only module migration and preserve clean-to-V12 plus V11-to-V12 coverage.
Complete only the inherited default-OFF non-durable PAY consumer port and fixtures; do not add durable PAY persistence.
Use canonical close-period fixtures only inside tests and never expose fixture provisioning as a production bean, route or job.
Remove Time runtime INSERT on tme_close_periods and runtime USAGE and SELECT on its BIGSERIAL sequence while retaining period SELECT and the sealed exact UPDATE columns.
A missing close period must produce an opaque not-found result and zero evidence, approval, outbox and handoff calls.
Expose stable result ownership and originating-authority revalidation methods for the later central CommandReceiptProvider adapter.
Record the close-period producer, PDX-011 live producer and durable PAY consumer as external gates.
Do not pre-provision future materializer privileges; they require a fresh owner decision, explicit execution principal or role and a fresh forward-only Time migration lease.

verification.policy: Run the bounded cluster once; after a failure rerun only the smallest failed target; do not run repository-wide suites per correction.
verification.frontendRerunReason: The reviewed frontend branch is clean, pushed and unchanged by this producer-control replacement.

invalidationConditions: the preserved backend WIP manifest differs before work resumes
the reviewed frontend commit, tree, upstream or clean state differs
any hash-bound decision or predecessor token bytes change
a second Time migration, PAY migration or path outside the exact touch boundary is required
a production period producer, create route, materializer or inferred authority is attempted
period INSERT or period-sequence privileges are restored without a fresh owner decision, explicitly allocated execution principal or role and fresh forward-only Time migration lease
the central transport, event, trust, product-authorization, receipt or immutable-result contract is weakened or locally shadowed
dwp-dev merge, central mount, activation, tenant enrollment, customer data or production release is attempted from the module session
